free_tier.stated: Reported free allowance of 20 API hits and 5 downloads a day, raised temporarily to 300 and 50 by the admin. caps declares <limits max="100" default="100"/> and <registration available="yes" open="no"/>.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: an NZB pointer file

retention.stated: not published on the pages reachable; a third-party tracker records the site as closed or offline as of 2026-10-06.

egress.terms: No byte metering; the API returns pointers. The HTML site answered with 14 words of text, which is a login shell, not content.

interface_detail: Newznab API at /api, 100 results per request. The web front end serves almost no server-rendered text (14 words to an extractor), so the caps endpoint is the only readable surface.
tooling: Native Newznab, so Prowlarr and NZBHydra2 can hold an entry, but only a key obtained during a registration window makes it work.
chaining: Nothing without an account; it is a membership to watch for a registration window rather than a usable index today.

limits.value: 20 API hits and 5 downloads per day free (reported), raised temporarily to 300 and 50

binding_note: Registration fails first; caps says open=no and a third-party tracker says the site is closed, so no quota is reachable.

identity_cost.detail: Closed. caps declares available=yes but open=no, which is the invite-only shape; a third-party tracker records 'Registration closed / site offline' checked 2026-10-06.

reliability_note: Third-party reports describe the site as offline while its API still answers caps, so reachability of the API is not evidence that the index is alive.
confidence_note: Registration closure is documented from the vendor's caps read today. Allowance and pricing are third-party.

evidence.proved: caps returned 200 and 2,898 bytes: title NinjaCentral, <limits max="100" default="100"/>, <registration available="yes" open="no"/>
the front end gave an extractor 14 words, under the 20-word threshold, so no page content was readable
third-party: 'dan 0 1 year, 2,000 API hits, 450 downloads EUR 15'; free limits once raised to 300 API hits and 50 downloads
